manifest.privacy_policy: All primary genomic analysis executes locally in-browser via Web Workers. No raw genotypes, rsIDs, or derived health indicators are transmitted to online endpoints.

CC.phenotype: APOE ε4/ε4 homozygote: ~12-15× elevated lifetime risk of late-onset Alzheimer's disease.

CT.phenotype: APOE ε4 carrier (ε3/ε4 or ε2/ε4): ~3-4× increased lifetime risk of late-onset Alzheimer's disease.

TT.phenotype: Non-ε4 at rs429358 (ε3 or ε2 allele present). Baseline population risk.

rs7412.name: APOE-ε2 determinant (c.526C>T, p.Arg176Cys)
rs7412.clinvar_condition: Hyperlipoproteinemia, type III / Alzheimer disease risk reduction

TT.phenotype: APOE ε2/ε2 homozygote: Lower risk of Alzheimer's; associated with Type III Hyperlipoproteinemia risk.

CT.phenotype: APOE ε2 carrier: Moderate protective effect against late-onset Alzheimer's disease.

CC.phenotype: Common baseline allele at rs7412 (encodes Arg176).

clinvar.condition: Hyperlipoproteinemia, type III / Alzheimer disease risk reduction

AA.phenotype: HFE C282Y homozygote: Primary genetic cause of Type 1 Hereditary Hemochromatosis (iron overload).

AG.phenotype: HFE C282Y carrier: Transmits allele to 50% of offspring. Risk of compound hemochromatosis if paired with H63D.

rs1799945.name: HFE H63D (c.187C>G, p.His63Asp)
rs1799945.clinvar_status: criteria provided, multiple submitters, no conflicts

GG.phenotype: HFE H63D homozygote: Low-penetrance modifier of iron absorption. Rarely causes clinical overload alone.

CG.phenotype: HFE H63D carrier: Mild modifier; clinical significance elevated primarily when in trans with C282Y.

clinvar.status: criteria provided, multiple submitters, no conflicts

rs6025.name: Factor V Leiden (c.1601G>A, p.Arg534Gln)
rs6025.clinvar_condition: Thrombophilia due to activated protein C resistance

TT.phenotype: Factor V Leiden homozygote: ~50-80× elevated lifetime risk of venous thromboembolism (VTE).

CT.phenotype: Factor V Leiden heterozygote: ~3-8× elevated risk of deep vein thrombosis and pulmonary embolism.

CC.phenotype: Normal genotype: Negative for Factor V Leiden.

clinvar.condition: Thrombophilia due to activated protein C resistance

rs1799963.name: Prothrombin G20210A (c.*97G>A)
rs1799963.clinvar_condition: Thrombophilia due to prothrombin deficiency or elevated levels

AA.phenotype: Prothrombin G20210A homozygote: Markedly elevated prothrombin levels and substantial thrombotic risk.

AG.phenotype: Prothrombin G20210A carrier: ~2-3× elevated risk of venous thromboembolism.

GG.phenotype: Normal genotype: Negative for Prothrombin G20210A.

clinvar.condition: Thrombophilia due to prothrombin deficiency or elevated levels

DD.phenotype: CFTR deltaF508 homozygote: Classic severe Cystic Fibrosis phenotype.

DI.phenotype: CFTR deltaF508 carrier: 50% recurrence risk to transmit to offspring.

II.phenotype: Normal genotype: Negative for CFTR deltaF508.

AA.phenotype: CYP2C19 Poor Metabolizer: Marked loss of clopidogrel bioactivation; consider alternative antiplatelet (prasugrel/ticagrelor).

AG.phenotype: CYP2C19 Intermediate Metabolizer: Reduced enzymatic clearance; clopidogrel resistance risk.

GG.phenotype: Provisional Normal Metabolizer at rs4244285. Full phenotype requires testing *3 and *17.

TT.phenotype: VKORC1 High Warfarin Sensitivity: Requires lower initial maintenance warfarin dosing to prevent bleeding.

CT.phenotype: VKORC1 Intermediate Sensitivity: Moderate dose reduction indicated per CPIC algorithms.

CC.phenotype: Normal VKORC1 expression: Standard initial maintenance warfarin dosing indicated.
SLCO1B1 Poor Function: High risk of statin-induced myopathy / rhabdomyolysis; avoid high-dose simvastatin.

CT.phenotype: SLCO1B1 Decreased Function: Moderate risk of statin myopathy; lower initial simvastatin dose recommended.

TT.phenotype: Normal SLCO1B1 hepatic uptake: Standard statin dosing tolerated.
DPYD Complete Deficiency: Lethal toxicity risk with 5-FU/capecitabine; fluoropyrimidines contraindicated.

CT.phenotype: DPYD Intermediate Deficiency: ~50% dose reduction of 5-FU/capecitabine strongly indicated per CPIC.

CC.phenotype: Normal DPYD genotype: Standard fluoropyrimidine dosing tolerated.

AA.phenotype: MTHFR 677TT homozygote: Thermolabile enzyme with ~30% residual activity; mild elevation of homocysteine.

AG.phenotype: MTHFR 677CT carrier: Modest enzyme thermolability (~65% residual activity); clinically unremarkable.

GG.phenotype: Primary adult lactose intolerance (hypolactasia): Reduced small intestine lactase after childhood.

AG.phenotype: Lactase persistent: Sustained lactose tolerance into adulthood.

AA.phenotype: Lactase persistent: Sustained lactose tolerance into adulthood.
ALDH2*2 homozygote: Near-complete loss of acetaldehyde dehydrogenase activity; severe flushing and toxicity.

AG.phenotype: ALDH2*2 heterozygote: Facial flushing, nausea, and tachycardia with alcohol; elevated esophageal cancer risk if consuming alcohol.
